description: dominofish pimc-stats: PIMC per-move time (median, p90, max) and nodes by tiles left, per mode, over the decisions of seeded games, measured twice with commit, thread count, and load; the default worlds per move is chosen from it for the 1 second per-move target on one core (rule recorded in docs/PLAN.md D18 first); the peak RSS of a PIMC engine process is recorded with /usr/bin/time -l and stays under 256 MB.
PIMC beats every baseline by SPRT on held-out duplicate pairs in both modes (run R4, pre-registered in docs/PLAN.md before it starts), reported in docs/eval/REPORT.md with per-move time and peak RSS.

Strength against worlds per move as a curve: PIMC at several world budgets against one fixed opponent on the same held-out pairs (run R5, pre-registered), each point with its 95% CI, reported in docs/eval/REPORT.md.
The gap to the omniscient bot: the omniscient bot (cheating) against PIMC on held-out pairs in both modes (run R6, pre-registered), the margin reported with its 95% CI in docs/eval/REPORT.md.

The first README results table for PIMC: README.md shows R4 (and the R5 curve and R6 gap) in the strength-claim format with each row's --fast reproduction (the first pairs of its run, same seeds and budgets), whose summary lines are committed beside the full results; dominofish report regenerates REPORT.md and check.sh fails on a stale one.
